verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the Message Batches API as a way to asynchronously process large volumes of Messages requests while cutting costs by 50% versus standard requests. The core story (async batch submission plus a documented discount) is therefore directly delivered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the batch discount, and detail on batch turnaround/limits in the evidence.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing

citations.quote: Process large volumes of Messages requests asynchronously with the Message Batches API, cutting costs by 50% and increasing throughput.
The Message Batches API is a powerful, cost-effective way to asynchronously process large volumes of Messages requests
